verdict.rationale: Postman's docs link to dedicated Variables and Environments pages (managing-environments), and a community user calls it invaluable for testing and validating APIs across environments, which points to environment-based switching. The evidence is mostly link titles, not descriptions of the workflow. Missing for 10: first-party detail on selecting or switching the active environment per request, explicit dev/staging/prod variable-set examples, variable scoping and precedence documentation, and hands-on corroboration of the switching workflow.
